# ZOE — account brief

## Who
ZOE runs personalized nutrition programs built on science, with at-home testing and daily guidance in the app ([source](https://joinzoe.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json in joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- react-native 0.74.5 in joinzoe/zoe-app/package.json ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json))
- CI workflows in joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- 16 public repos and 88 followers on the joinzoe org ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe))
- The org description names a regulated category, health ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe))
- 22,000 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982))
- 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982))
- ZOE listed in "Ask HN: Who is hiring? (August 2026)" on 2026-08-03 ([source](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45121440)) and in the July 2026 thread on 2026-07-01 ([source](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44890211))

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@joinzoe-maintainer-1), top contributor to joinzoe/zoe-app with 121 commits ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)). No title or team listed.
- Maintainer Two (@joinzoe-maintainer-2), 70 commits to joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-2)). No title or team listed.
- Maintainer Three (@joinzoe-maintainer-3), 28 commits to joinzoe/zoe-app ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company ZOE and website https://joinzoe.com ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-3)). No title or team listed.

## Why now
joinzoe/zoe-app was last pushed 2026-08-17 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app)) and the app shipped 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
You have 121 commits in joinzoe/zoe-app, which is on react-native 0.74.5 with an eas.json and GitHub Actions workflows in the repo ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/package.json)) ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/blob/main/eas.json)) ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)). The app shipped 8 App Store releases in the last 90 days and the repo was last pushed 2026-08-17 ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zoe-personalized-nutrition/id1546855982)) ([source](https://github.com/joinzoe/zoe-app)). With that cadence, do your workflows hand the build off to EAS and ship JS fixes over the air, or does every fix wait on store review?
